checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the portrait
must.why: Same face, hair, sweater and park background in all frames.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: The video audio was not available to check. The assistant itself said it had not watched the video.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: The mouth is open mid-speech at 0.8 s and 3.2 s. It is closed at 5.6 s and 7.6 s, so speech seems to end before then. Sync can't be fully judged from stills.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with audible friendly female English speech
must.why: The frames are square and span 8 s. The video's audio can't be heard, so the voice and its audibility can't be confirmed.
No text appears in any frame.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text, as requested. The spoken words can't be verified.

faults.what: In the last frames (5.6 s and 7.6 s) the mouth is closed and her eyes are shut. She is idle for the final 2+ seconds, which looks a bit odd. The speech may also end early.
Slight softness and AI-like look at 480p. The face is otherwise stable with no warping.

summary: The result is a square talking-photo video that keeps her identity, has no captions and shows the mouth moving. The spoken words are unverified, and she sits idle with closed eyes at the end.
